reliabilityRationale: Not itself a government source — it is a commercial nursing-career media site. Reliability is elevated above a typical blog because its board directory was cross-checked against the NCSBN member directory during this research pass and the two agreed on every one of the 50 states checked. Still lower than a .gov/official-board source; board name/URL facts sourced from it should be treated as 'likely' rather than 'verified' until a human independently re-confirms a sample.
authorityRationale: Nurse.org is a commercial nursing-career media company, not a government body, licensing board, or compact organization. It does not issue, administer, or govern any licensing fact itself. Its board directory was cross-checked against the NCSBN member list during Phase 1 research and the two agreed, which is why reliabilityScore is elevated to 0.75 rather than a typical blog's ~0.3-0.5 — but per the Verification Policy, a secondary source can never by itself be sufficient to mark a field Verified, regardless of reliabilityScore.
